page_title: ACM 3-1 ROM | AC Milan v AS Roma 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Half-chance! Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+3' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

90+2' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the left post!
89' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Theo Hernandez and he is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
89' It will be a substitution. Kevin Zeroli (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Yacine Adli walks off.
87' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is caught offside yet again.
86' The corner kick from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

86' A sweet pass finds Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Mike Maignan is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
84' 3 - 1 Olivier Giroud plays a neat ball into the path of Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 3:1.
81' Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
81' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
79' Here comes a substitution. Rafael Leao is given a rest as he is replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christian Pulisic as he is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
78' Here comes a substitution. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Zeki Celik.
78' Here is a change. Diego Llorente is going off and Salvatore Foti gives the last tactical orders to Dean Huijsen (AS Roma).
78' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is caught offside once again.
77' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
76' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
76' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
74' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
73' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
73' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) on the edge of the box. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
71' AS Roma get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
71' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
70' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
69' 2 - 1 Goal! Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mike Maignan into middle of the goal.
69' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is going to take the penalty!
67' Referee Marco Guida sees the trip by Davide Calabria (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. AS Roma are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
66' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.

64' Mile Svilar doesn't have to worry about this one. Rafael Leao plays a pass into the feet of Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
62' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy makes way for Andrea Belotti (AS Roma).
56' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
56' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
56' 2 - 0 GOAL! Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) scores with a header from close range after Simon Kjaer headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 2:0.
56' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
55' Theo Hernandez swings in the free kick towards Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan), who powers a header well wide of the left post from close in.
53' Marco Guida blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) brought his opponent down. A free kick is awarded to AC Milan.
51' A precise low pass is received by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
49' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
48' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a reproachful look from Christian Pulisic. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
46' Salvatore Foti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Lorenzo Pellegrini comes on the pitch for Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma).
46' The whistle blows and Marco Guida starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) will miss the next game.
43' The game is interrupted. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
42' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
41' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

40' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) collects the ball on the edge of the box and produces a precise shot which would have ended in the bottom left corner, if Mike Maignan hadn't pulled off a wonderful save.
39' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
37' Rafael Leao clips a neat ball into the box towards Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
36' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
31' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) comes to nothing.

30' Excellent touch by Zeki Celik (AS Roma)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' What a chance that is! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!

27' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Mile Svilar.
27' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
24' The ball is cleared after Zeki Celik (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' The total number of attempts is 3:1. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
18' The free kick is delivered by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

18' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick to AS Roma.
16' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement. AC Milan will take a free kick.
15' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is teed up on the edge of the box by Tijjani Reijnders, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
8' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
6' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
3' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
3' A pass into the penalty area from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
1' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mile Svilar with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida will supervise the game today.
